# Logic-Variables Registry
*Auto-generated by `npm run logic-vars-docs` — do NOT edit manually.*
*Regenerate after seeding a new logic variable; the `logic-vars-registry.infra.test.ts` drift guard fails CI on staleness.*

The single AI-operator index of every Control-Panel logic variable: default,
bounds, numeric-vs-JSONB, description, and the pipeline scripts that consume it.
Values are operator-tunable at runtime via the Spec 86 Control Panel; the
defaults below are the seed / migration baselines.

- **Numeric vars** (422) live in `scripts/seeds/logic_variables.json` (the parity-tested surface re-exported as `LOGIC_VAR_DEFAULTS` in `src/lib/admin/control-panel.ts`), except the 19 seeded via migrations only (last column notes the migration).
- **JSONB vars** (6) carry non-numeric values in `logic_variables.variable_value_json`; they are migration-seeded (never in the seed JSON — a JSONB value cannot live in the numeric `variable_value` column) and read directly (config-loader passes object JSON through untouched).
- **Consuming scripts** are derived from each script's local `LOGIC_VARS_SCHEMA = z.object({...})` Zod union. A blank cell means no static consumer was found; some consumers read **computed keys** (e.g. `assert-lifecycle-phase-distribution.js` builds `lifecycle_band_${…}` at runtime) invisible to a static scan — those are named in the seed JSON's `CONSUMED by …` annotation, surfaced in the Description.

**Cross-refs:** Spec 40 (`docs/specs/01-pipeline/40_pipeline_system.md`, config-loader / logicVars contract) · Spec 86 (`docs/specs/02-web-admin/86_control_panel.md`, the Control Panel that edits these).

Total: **428** logic variables (422 numeric, 6 JSONB).

| `load_ravines_count_drift_fail_pct` | numeric | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | — | seed | Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 2, INGESTOR) — L7 feature-count drift bound: \|loaded − prior\| / prior above this FAILs the run before any DB write. 0.5 = the pre-externalization literal (ravineDriftFeatureCountPct). Bound to check ravine_count_drift_pct through checks[].limit_from_config, so the resolved value renders as the audit row threshold. RAVINE_ACCEPT_FEATURE_COUNT_DRIFT=1 lets the run proceed but never suppresses the FAIL row. CONSUMED by load_ravines (scripts/lib/compute/load-ravines.js ravine_count_drift_pct, via ctx.config). |
| `load_ravines_dataset_age_warn_years` | numeric | 20 | 1 – 200 | — | seed | Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 2, INGESTOR) — how many years the Ravine + Natural Feature Protection archive may sit unchanged upstream before the dataset-age audit row escalates from INFO to WARN. 20 = the pre-externalization ConfigSchema literal (ravineSkipCheckThresholdYears). The CKAN resource has been frozen at Mon, 14 Mar 2022 since publication, so at 20 the row stays INFO until 2042; lower it to make the staleness of a genuinely abandoned source visible sooner. It moves a WARN, never a write. CONSUMED by load_ravines (scripts/lib/compute/load-ravines.js ravine_dataset_age_years, via ctx.config). |
| `load_ravines_download_timeout_ms` | numeric | 60000 | 1000 – 600000 | — | seed | Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 2, INGESTOR) — AbortController budget for BOTH CKAN calls the acquisition seam makes (the pre-acquisition HEAD and the streamed ZIP GET). 60000 = the pre-externalization literal (ravineDownloadTimeoutMs) and is mirrored into descriptor execution.network.timeout, which must AGREE. Raise it when the CKAN edge is slow rather than letting a timeout read as an acquisition FAIL. CONSUMED by load_ravines (scripts/lib/step/acquire.js headValidators + downloadArchive, via ctx.config). |
| `load_ravines_geometry_update_warn_pct` | numeric | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | — | seed | Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 2, INGESTOR) — L7b geometry-update drift bound: updated / prior_feature_count above this WARNs (never halts). 0.5 = the pre-externalization literal (ravineDriftGeometryUpdatePct). Bound to check ravine_geometry_update_pct through checks[].limit_from_config. A high update ratio on a source frozen since 2022 means the upstream geometry was silently re-cut — worth a human look, not a refusal. CONSUMED by load_ravines (scripts/lib/compute/load-ravines.js ravine_geometry_update_pct, via ctx.config). |
| `load_ravines_invalid_geometry_fail_pct` | numeric | 0.05 | 0 – 1 | — | seed | Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 2, INGESTOR) — L8 invalid-geometry bound: skipped / feature_count above this FAILs the run BEFORE the transaction opens, so no partial polygon set is ever committed. 0.05 = the pre-externalization literal (ravineInvalidGeometryFailPct) and the same 5% the downstream consumer enrich-ravines.js re-checks at :57 — move both together or producer and consumer disagree. CONSUMED by load_ravines (scripts/lib/compute/load-ravines.js ravine_geometry_skipped_pct, via ctx.config). |
| `load_ravines_mass_delete_fail_pct` | numeric | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | — | seed | Spec 122 §1.2a P4 (Pilot 2, INGESTOR) — L7c mass-deletion bound: deleted / prior_feature_count above this FAILs the run (fence 1ceebd17, Severity HIGH — the abort was non-functional pre-review). 0.5 = the pre-externalization literal (ravineMassDeletePct). Bound to check ravine_mass_delete_pct through checks[].limit_from_config; RAVINE_ACCEPT_MASS_DELETE=1 lets an acknowledged full reload COMPLETE but never suppresses the FAIL row. CONSUMED by load_ravines (scripts/lib/compute/load-ravines.js ravine_mass_delete_pct, via ctx.config). |
